description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultScopedConfig class, verifying immutability, equality, exception handling, and path retrieval logic.

classes.name: DefaultScopedConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultScopedConfig, testing immutability, equality, exception cases, and configuration path handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading a test configuration.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultScopedConfig instances are immutable and config instances are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the equals and hashCode implementations of DefaultScopedConfig.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOriginalConfig
methods.description: Tests that creating a DefaultScopedConfig with null config throws a proper exception.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullConfigPath
methods.description: Tests that creating a DefaultScopedConfig with null config path throws a proper exception.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithMissingConfigAtConfigPath
methods.description: Checks that attempting to create a scoped config from a missing path throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithWrongTypeAtConfigPath
methods.description: Checks that wrong type at the config path produces an exception.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsRelativePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromPlainConfig
methods.description: Ensures default path is 'ditto' when created from a plain config.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsAbsolutePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromScopedConfig
methods.description: Ensures combined path is correct when created from a nested config.

methods.name: tryToGetMissingValue
methods.description: Checks that accessing a missing value throws a consistent exception.

methods.name: getIntValueAlthoughConfigContainsString
methods.description: Verifies that a numeric value stored as string can be correctly retrieved as int.
